lines.zh: 六条腿在树皮上跑，比在平地快。
lines.en: Six legs run faster on bark than on flat ground.

lines.zh: 我拖着一颗橡子，比身体还大。
lines.en: I drag an acorn bigger than my whole body.

lines.zh: 沿着树根走，就不会迷路。
lines.en: Follow the roots, and I won't get lost.

lines.zh: 长鼻子先探路，我随后跟上。
lines.en: My long snout feels the way; I follow behind it.

lines.zh: 叶子背面很滑，我走得很小心。
lines.en: The underside of the leaf is slick; I step carefully.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把触角转了个方向。
lines.en: I stop and swing my antennae a different way.

lines.zh: 落叶堆里走一趟，背上全是碎屑。
lines.en: A walk through the leaf litter leaves crumbs on my back.

lines.zh: 前面那颗橡子被虫占了，绕开。
lines.en: That acorn ahead is taken by another grub; around it.

lines.zh: 我背上有点痒，是沾了花粉。
lines.en: My back itches a little; pollen stuck to it.

lines.zh: 树根的缝够我钻进去。
lines.en: The gap between roots is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，橡子会掉。
lines.en: Slow down, or the acorn drops.

lines.zh: 我的壳是橡木色的，很难被看见。
lines.en: My shell is oak-brown, so I'm hard to spot.

lines.zh: 今天我打算去那棵最老的橡树。
lines.en: Today I plan to visit the oldest oak.

lines.zh: 我用长鼻子敲了敲橡子的壳。
lines.en: I tap the acorn shell with my long snout.

lines.zh: 太阳晒到背上，壳就暖了。
lines.en: Sun on my back warms the shell right through.

lines.zh: 我在等橡子自己掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for the acorn to fall on its own.

lines.zh: 触角抖一抖，能闻到很远的东西。
lines.en: A flick of my antennae and I smell far-off things.

lines.zh: 树上的鸟叫，我一点都不怕。
lines.en: The birds up in the tree don't frighten me.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进落叶里，只露鼻子。
lines.en: I bury myself in leaves with only my snout out.

lines.zh: 我把腿一根根擦干净。
lines.en: I wipe each of my legs clean in turn.

lines.zh: 橡树的花粉落下来，像细雪。
lines.en: Oak pollen drifts down like fine snow.

lines.zh: 我在算今天要搬几趟。
lines.en: I'm working out how many trips today needs.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁路过，我们互相看了看。
lines.en: An ant passes by; we look at each other.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，壳里会有一点响。
lines.en: In the quiet, there's a small sound inside my shell.

lines.zh: 这个洞我挖了三天，刚好容身。
lines.en: I dug this hole for three days; it just fits me.

lines.zh: 树叶落了一片，正盖住我的门。
lines.en: A leaf falls and covers my doorway exactly.

lines.zh: 我把橡子摆在洞边，排成一列。
lines.en: I line my acorns up along the edge of my hole.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子探进壳口，闻了闻。
lines.en: I poke my snout into the shell and sniff.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗橡子，是给谁留的？
lines.en: That acorn in your hand — who were you saving it for?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，长鼻子对着你。
lines.en: I look up with my long snout pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的时候，地面在抖。
lines.en: The ground shakes when you crouch down.

lines.zh: 你的手很大，橡子却拿得很好。
lines.en: Your hand is huge, yet you hold the acorn well.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，橡树林里见得多。
lines.en: People don't scare me; the oak grove sees many.

lines.zh: 你把帽子摘了，光落在我身上。
lines.en: You took your hat off, and light falls on me.

lines.zh: 我爬到你的鞋上，走了一步。
lines.en: I climb onto your shoe and take a step.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也在看你的口袋。
lines.en: You look at me; I look at your pocket.

lines.zh: 你身上有树汁的味道。
lines.en: You smell of tree sap.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I raise my front legs as if to say hello.

lines.zh: 你那么高，我脖子都仰酸了。
lines.en: You're so tall my neck aches from looking up.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我就凉快了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me, and I cool down.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，闻了一半的鞋底。
lines.en: I circle you, sniffing half of your sole.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，牙齿比橡子白。
lines.en: When you laugh, your teeth are whiter than acorns.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是攥着橡子？
lines.en: Are you holding acorns in that hand?

lines.zh: 你走得慢，我就跟得上。
lines.en: You walk slow, so I can keep up.

lines.zh: 你弯腰，我顺着袖口爬。
lines.en: You bend down and I climb your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里歇一会儿。
lines.en: I will rest a while in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你把土块捏在手心，干嘛？
lines.en: Why are you packing dirt into your palm?

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，比橡子还大。
lines.en: Your breathing is louder than an acorn.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我用腿捂住。
lines.en: A crack opens in my shell; I cover it with a leg.

lines.zh: 我被踩进土里，又爬出来。
lines.en: I'm pressed into the soil and crawl back out.

lines.zh: 这一下把我翻了过来。
lines.en: That blow flipped me onto my back.

lines.zh: 腿断了一根，走起来歪。
lines.en: One leg is broken; I walk crooked now.

lines.zh: 壳沿崩了一小块，我往里缩。
lines.en: A chip broke off my shell rim; I shrink deeper inside.

lines.zh: 橡子掉了，我顾不上去捡。
lines.en: The acorn fell, and I can't stop for it.

lines.zh: 鼻子撞弯了，闻东西不灵。
lines.en: My snout is bent; smelling doesn't work right.

lines.zh: 我疼得发抖，但没出声。
lines.en: I shake with the pain but make no sound.

lines.zh: 壳里那点软肉，被碰到了。
lines.en: The soft part inside my shell got hit.

lines.zh: 我往树根那边爬，那儿安全。
lines.en: I crawl toward the roots, where it's safe.

lines.zh: 橡子的味道出来了，我停不住了。
lines.en: That acorn smell is out; I can't hold still.

lines.zh: 你把橡子放低，我就往前挪。
lines.en: Lower the acorn, and I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 这颗壳上有小孔，是最甜的。
lines.en: This shell has a tiny hole; those are the sweetest.

lines.zh: 我伸出长鼻子，够到了。
lines.en: I stretch my long snout out and reach it.

lines.zh: 再多一颗，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One more acorn, and I'll come along.

lines.zh: 地上那颗滚远了，我追过去。
lines.en: That one rolled away; I go after it.

lines.zh: 橡子壳裂开的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: The sound of an acorn shell cracking is my favorite.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等你的手松开。
lines.en: I won't snatch it; I'll wait for your hand to open.

lines.zh: 头一回闻到这么新鲜的。
lines.en: I've never smelled one this fresh.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比腿还长，就是为了这个。
lines.en: My snout is longer than my legs, all for this.

lines.zh: 壳里的仁有点干，但很香。
lines.en: The meat inside is a bit dry, but fragrant.

lines.zh: 我把橡子抱在怀里，谁也不给。
lines.en: I hug the acorn to myself and share with nobody.

lines.zh: 你手指一松，我就扑上去。
lines.en: The moment your fingers loosen, I pounce.

lines.zh: 这一颗足够我吃到明天。
lines.en: This one will last me until tomorrow.

lines.zh: 橡子在地上转了半圈，我跟着。
lines.en: The acorn rolls once and I follow.

lines.zh: 先把壳咬开，再谈别的。
lines.en: Let me crack the shell first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 你的手掌摊平，我就上来。
lines.en: Open your palm flat and I will climb on.

lines.zh: 你差点踩到我，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: You nearly stepped on me; I rolled over once.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的鞋上，弹回去了。
lines.en: I bump your shoe and bounce back.

lines.zh: 壳被撞得响了一下，没事。
lines.en: My shell clacked on impact; I'm fine.

lines.zh: 你走路的震动，把我震下叶子。
lines.en: Your footsteps shake me right off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我被撞翻，用腿慢慢翻回来。
lines.en: I get knocked on my back and slowly right myself.

lines.zh: 别用脚尖碰我，太重了。
lines.en: Don't nudge me with your toe; it's too heavy.

lines.zh: 我钻到你的影子里躲一下。
lines.en: I slip into your shadow to hide a moment.

lines.zh: 撞到树根，我又绕回去。
lines.en: I hit a root and go around it again.

lines.zh: 那颗橡子被我撞掉了。
lines.en: I knocked that acorn loose.

lines.zh: 你停下，我才敢继续走。
lines.en: You stop, and only then do I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰她，她回碰了两下。
lines.en: I touch her with my antennae; she touches back twice.

lines.zh: 我把最大的一颗橡子推给她。
lines.en: I push the biggest acorn over to her.

lines.zh: 我们在树皮缝里挖了同一个小洞。
lines.en: We dig one small hollow in the bark together.

lines.zh: 她的壳比我深一点，像老木头。
lines.en: Her shell is a shade darker, like old wood.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，沿着同一根枝条。
lines.en: One behind the other, we take the same branch.

lines.zh: 她走慢，我就停在原地等。
lines.en: She walks slowly, so I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 树下的落叶，够我们过完这一季。
lines.en: The fallen leaves below will see us through the season.

lines.zh: 两颗橡子放在一起，谁也没动。
lines.en: Two acorns side by side, and neither of us takes them.

lines.zh: 她用鼻子碰我，声音极小。
lines.en: She taps me with her snout, barely a sound.

lines.zh: 到了秋天，这片林子会更大。
lines.en: By autumn, this grove will be bigger.

lines.zh: 这颗橡子滚到我脚边，归我。
lines.en: This acorn rolled to my feet; it's mine.

lines.zh: 我用前腿抱着它，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I hug it with my front legs and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 壳上有个洞，正好放鼻子。
lines.en: There's a hole in the shell, just right for my snout.

lines.zh: 落叶底下还有一颗，我刨出来。
lines.en: Another one under the leaves; I dig it out.

lines.zh: 我把橡子藏进树根的缝里。
lines.en: I hide the acorn in a crack between roots.

lines.zh: 这颗太小，我先不拿。
lines.en: This one's too small; I'll leave it.

lines.zh: 我推着它走，比抱着省力。
lines.en: I push it along; easier than carrying.

lines.zh: 土块粘在壳上，我抖了两下。
lines.en: Dirt clings to the shell; I shake it twice.

lines.zh: 我把最好的留给明天早上。
lines.en: I save the best one for tomorrow morning.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都藏在同一个洞。
lines.en: Everything I find goes into the same hole.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近我的橡子堆了。
lines.en: Something is nearing my acorn pile.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻子对准那个方向。
lines.en: I lift my head and point my snout that way.

lines.zh: 那只甲虫一直盯着我的树洞。
lines.en: That beetle keeps watching my tree hollow.

lines.zh: 你先动的，我可记住了。
lines.en: You moved first; I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 他踩坏了我的橡子壳。
lines.en: He crushed my acorn shell.

lines.zh: 我爬到高处，看得清楚些。
lines.en: I climb higher for a clearer look.

lines.zh: 那家伙在翻我的落叶堆。
lines.en: That one is rummaging through my leaf pile.

lines.zh: 触角向前伸，我闻到了敌意。
lines.en: Antennae forward, I smell hostility.

lines.zh: 这个仇，得用土块来还。
lines.en: This grudge gets paid back in dirt clods.

lines.zh: 我记住了他的鞋，跑不掉。
lines.en: I've memorized his shoes; he can't hide.

lines.zh: 我站到橡子上，好瞄准一些。
lines.en: I climb onto an acorn for a better aim.

lines.zh: 土块在腿间，随时能扔。
lines.en: A dirt clod is between my legs, ready to throw.

lines.zh: 他往左走，我就往左偏。
lines.en: He goes left, so I angle left.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我扔得准。
lines.en: At this distance, I throw straight.

lines.zh: 他背对着我，正好。
lines.en: His back is to me; perfect.

lines.zh: 我等他把手放下来。
lines.en: I wait for him to lower his hands.

lines.zh: 土块要压紧，不然会散。
lines.en: The clod must be packed tight or it breaks apart.

lines.zh: 我先扔一颗试试风向。
lines.en: I'll throw one first to test the wind.

lines.zh: 他站住了，我就不用追。
lines.en: If he stands still, I needn't chase.

lines.zh: 橡子堆在后面，我不能退。
lines.en: The acorn pile is behind me; I can't retreat.

lines.zh: 第一块土砸在他膝盖上。
lines.en: The first clod hits him on the knee.

lines.zh: 我抡起前腿，把土甩出去。
lines.en: I swing my front legs and fling the dirt.

lines.zh: 土块散了，他一脸都是灰。
lines.en: The clod bursts, and his face is covered in dust.

lines.zh: 我连着扔了三块，都中了。
lines.en: I throw three in a row, and all three land.

lines.zh: 他抬手挡，正好挡在脸上。
lines.en: He raises a hand, right across his face.

lines.zh: 我从侧面绕，往他后颈扔。
lines.en: I circle to the side and throw at his neck.

lines.zh: 这一块有点湿，砸得更重。
lines.en: This one's damp, so it hits heavier.

lines.zh: 他退了两步，我就再压上。
lines.en: He backs off two steps; I press closer.

lines.zh: 泥土进了他的眼睛，他看不见。
lines.en: Dirt gets in his eyes and he can't see.

lines.zh: 扔完这一块，我得去补货。
lines.en: After this throw, I need to restock.

lines.zh: 我从橡子壳里钻出来，天刚亮。
lines.en: I crawl out of the acorn shell at first light.

lines.zh: 壳还挂在背上，像件小甲。
lines.en: The shell still clings to my back like small armor.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找最近的那棵树。
lines.en: First thing: find the nearest oak.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比身体先长出来。
lines.en: My snout grew before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 落叶的味道，就是家的味道。
lines.en: The smell of fallen leaves is the smell of home.

lines.zh: 树皮上有很多路，我挑了一条。
lines.en: There are many paths on the bark; I pick one.

lines.zh: 露水太重，我走一步滑一步。
lines.en: The dew is heavy; every step slips.

lines.zh: 这片林子今年结得不错。
lines.en: This grove has done well this year.

lines.zh: 我爬上去，找到了第一个洞。
lines.en: I climb up and find my first hollow.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这棵树归我住。
lines.en: From today, this tree is where I live.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我赶紧跑。
lines.en: My shell turns hot; I run as fast as I can.

lines.zh: 从树上掉下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and land on my shell.

lines.zh: 掉进水洼，腿上沾满了泥。
lines.en: I drop into a puddle, legs caked with mud.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹到树那边去了。
lines.en: The blast blows me clear over to the tree.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边的树皮上。
lines.en: An arrow pins itself into the bark beside me.

lines.zh: 紫光让我六条腿一起发僵。
lines.en: Violet light stiffens all six of my legs at once.

lines.zh: 橡子吃完了，我只能啃树皮。
lines.en: The acorns are gone; I gnaw bark instead.

lines.zh: 雷劈在橡树上，我壳里发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the oak, and my shell tingles.

lines.zh: 这里没有树，也没有橡子。
lines.en: There's no tree here, and no acorns.
